# What Shopify app secret keys the library redacts, and what it leaves alone.
#
# Every key here is built from the ordered run 0123456789abcdef, which no real
# credential is: a body is thirty-two hexadecimal characters, so the run twice
# over is one, and the six character prefix in front brings a key to
# thirty-eight.

patterns: shopify-app-secret-key

# The secret half of an app's client credentials, which Shopify's changelog calls
# an app secret key and its current reference page a client secret. It is a
# pattern of its own rather than part of the access token beside it because the
# two are held by different parties and leak to different effect: a token exposes
# one shop's session, this key exposes every install of the app.

case:     an app secret key in the variable shopify's own libraries read it from
in:       SHOPIFY_API_SECRET=shpss_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef
out:      SHOPIFY_API_SECRET=«shopify-app-secret-key»

case:     a key in a yaml assignment
in:       client_secret: shpss_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef
out:      client_secret: «shopify-app-secret-key»

case:     a key in a json body beside the client id
in:       {"client_id":"0123456789abcdef","client_secret":"shpss_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef"}
out:      {"client_id":"0123456789abcdef","client_secret":"«shopify-app-secret-key»"}

case:     a key in the command line that prints it
in:       shopify app env show --client-secret shpss_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef
out:      shopify app env show --client-secret «shopify-app-secret-key»

# The alphabet is hexadecimal in either case, on the same evidence as the access
# token's: the rulesets read it without regard to case and trufflehog's own cases
# carry a body written wholly in uppercase beside one written wholly in
# lowercase.

case:     a body written in uppercase
in:       shpss_0123456789ABCDEF0123456789ABCDEF
out:      «shopify-app-secret-key»

case:     a letter past f in the body is no key
in:       shpss_0123456789abcdefg123456789abcdef
out:      shpss_0123456789abcdefg123456789abcdef

# The count is exact, and the prefix is read in lowercase alone.

case:     a body one character short is no key
in:       shpss_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcde
out:      shpss_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcde

case:     a run longer than the count is a key and what follows it
in:       shpss_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0
out:      «shopify-app-secret-key»0

case:     an uppercase prefix is the shape a variable's name is written in
in:       SHPSS_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef
out:      SHPSS_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef

# The access token's kinds are read by the pattern beside this one, so this set
# reports nothing for any of them. That is the boundary between the two doing its
# work: a caller enabling one is not enabling the other.

case:     a public app access token is no key of this kind
in:       shpat_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef
out:      shpat_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef

case:     the secret format this one replaced
in:       SHOPIFY_API_SECRET=0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef
out:      SHOPIFY_API_SECRET=0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef

# There is no word boundary either side of a match.

case:     a key written straight against a name
in:       SECRET_shpss_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef
out:      SECRET_«shopify-app-secret-key»

case:     two keys with nothing between them
in:       shpss_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdefshpss_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef
out:      «shopify-app-secret-key»«shopify-app-secret-key»

case:     prose naming an app secret
in:       the app secret should be stored outside the repository
out:      the app secret should be stored outside the repository
